Maya (PM): Quick sync — need to lock MVP vs v1. Proposed MVP = core chat + embeddings cache + basic routing. Defer: multi-tenant SSO, advanced batching, model-edit UI. Aim for beta by 4/15. Thoughts?
Liam (Eng): We can drop model-edit UI. But if we defer batching it bumps per-token cost; what's acceptable latency/cost tradeoff?
Maya (PM): Target p95 < 500ms for short inputs; for long sequences degrade gracefully. We're ok with up to ~2x cost in beta but not more.
Sophia (Design): If SSO is delayed we need an explicit 'Enterprise' CTA and onboarding copy. Also add telemetry hooks to measure drop-off. :eyes:
Devon (ML): For MVP let's pin to open-llama-13b quantized. For v1 support other families with fallback. I will assemble an eval promptset to catch regressions.
Arun (Eng): Operationally deferring batching simplifies infra. Recommend keeping embeddings cache enabled — cheap perf win. Also propose a feature flag: `mvp_batched_inference` default=false.
Liam (Eng): Agree on embeddings cache. Quick config snippet for flags/rollout:
```
feature_flags:
  mvp_batched_inference: false
  embeddings_cache: true
rollout:
  percent: 100
```
Maya (PM): Add telemetry gates: track `p95_latency`, `cost_per_1k_tokens`, `error_rate`, and `engagement_rate`. We'll gate rollout on these.
Arun (Eng): I'll hook those into Console dashboards. ETA 3 days. :+1:
Sophia (Design): I'll add a beta banner and emit `user_triggered_chat` analytic event.
Liam (Eng): Action: prepare staging canary with model pinned + feature flags off. I'll own the canary. ETA Tue next week.
Devon (ML): I'll drop `promptset_v0.2` into the repo and compute baseline scores before canary.
Maya (PM): @Liam @Arun define rollback criteria: auto-rollback if p95 > 1s OR error_rate > 1%. Agree?
Liam (Eng): :thumbsup: I'll add a circuit-breaker in the router that flips `canary_enable=false` on threshold breach.
Arun (Eng): release-bot: scheduling staging -> canary deploy. Will set monitoring alerts and slack hooks.
release-bot: Deploy queued: staging -> prod canary by @Liam on 2024-04-01T15:00Z. Logs: https://ci.internal/release/3498765432
Maya (PM): Final decision: MVP = core chat + embeddings cache + pinned open-llama-13b quantized. Defer SSO, batching, model-edit UI to v1. Rollout path: staging canary -> 10% prod -> 100% if metrics pass. Owners: Liam (canary), Arun (telemetry), Devon (eval), Sophia (copy).
Liam (Eng): I'll open the tracking ticket, add the feature flags, and post the canary checklist. @Maya confirm timeline?
Maya (PM): Confirmed. Locking MVP and moving v1 items to milestone `v1-2024-Q3`.
Sophia (Design): I'll deliver beta banner + CTA mock by EOD today.
Liam (Eng): :shipit:
